fields.description: Mail cluster users connect to, e.g. https://mail.blr.frappemail.com. Frappe Cloud writes it into the site config; set it here to override.
fields.label: JMAP URL

fields.description: Verify the mail cluster's SSL certificate. Disable only for local development against a self-signed certificate.
fields.label: Verify SSL

fields.description: Suite Cloud that manages this site's domains, accounts, groups and lists, e.g. https://cloud.frappemail.com. Frappe Cloud writes it into the site config; set it here to override.
fields.label: Suite Cloud URL

fields.description: This site's key at Suite Cloud, issued when Frappe Cloud registered the site.
fields.label: Site API Key

fields.description: This site's secret at Suite Cloud, shown once by Frappe Cloud. Rotate it from Frappe Cloud if it leaks.
fields.label: Site API Secret

fields.description: Show SMTP, IMAP and POP connection details in the Mail UI so users can set up third-party mail clients.
fields.label: Show Connection Details in Mail UI

fields.description: Show CalDAV connection details in the Calendar UI so users can set up third-party calendar clients.
fields.label: Show Connection Details in Calendar UI

fields.description: Connection endpoints shown to users. Leave empty to fall back to the domain's DNS records.
fields.label: Mail Client Configuration
Host
fields.description: SpamAssassin daemon (spamd) that scans messages, e.g. spamd.example.com. Leave blank to skip spam checks.

fields.label: Port
fields.description: Port spamd listens on; 783 is its default.

fields.label: Scanning Mode
fields.options:
Exclude Attachments
Include Attachments
Hybrid Approach
fields.description: What spamd receives: the whole message, the message without attachments, or the hybrid approach, which scans without attachments first and sends the whole message only when that pass scores at or above the threshold.

fields.label: Hybrid Scanning Threshold
fields.description: Spam score of the attachment-free pass at or above which the whole message is scanned again.

fields.label: Default Disk Quota (GB)
fields.description: Disk quota, in GB, for accounts created without one.
Use Gravatar for default user images. Gravatar is a third-party service; enabling this shares hashed email addresses with it. When disabled, initials are shown instead.
fields.label: Enable Gravatar

fields.description: Image Gravatar serves for addresses that have no Gravatar. 404 uses a locally generated identicon instead.
fields.label: Default Gravatar
fields.options:
404
mp
identicon
monsterid
wavatar
retro
robohash
blank

fields.description: Let visitors create their own mail account with a username of their choice on one of the signup domains.
fields.label: Allow Signup

fields.description: One domain per line. Each must be one of this site's mail domains.
fields.label: Signup Domains

fields.description: Send calendar invitation, update and cancellation emails from Frappe Mail using the templates below, with .ics attachments and HTTP RSVP links. When disabled, the JMAP server handles scheduling messages instead.
fields.label: Send Custom Event Invitations

fields.description: Invite a mailing list's members individually when the list address is added to an event. The server expands a list only when delivering mail, so an invitation addressed to the list reaches every inbox but is never added to calendars.
fields.label: Expand Mailing List Participants

fields.description: Largest number of participants an event may carry once its mailing lists have been expanded. Only members added by expansion are left out and reported; participants invited by name are always kept.
fields.label: Max Mailing List Participants

fields.description: Create push subscriptions with the keys below so the JMAP server encrypts push payloads end to end. Leave disabled to receive push notifications as plain JSON.
fields.label: Enable Push Encryption

fields.description: Authentication secret for push encryption. Generated by Actions, Generate JMAP Push Keys.
fields.label: JMAP Push Auth Secret

fields.description: ECDH P-256 private key that decrypts incoming push notifications. Generated by Actions, Generate JMAP Push Keys.
fields.label: JMAP Push Private Key

fields.description: P-256 public key sent to the JMAP server when subscribing. Generated by Actions, Generate JMAP Push Keys.
fields.label: JMAP Push Key (P256DH)
Exchange Max Export
fields.description: Most items one export job may contain, for mail, contacts and calendars alike.

fields.label: Exchange Max Import
fields.description: Most items one import job may contain, for mail, contacts and calendars alike.

fields.label: Exchange Export Batch Size
fields.description: Messages downloaded per batch while exporting mail.

fields.label: Max Email Sync
fields.description: Most emails one pull request may fetch from a mailbox.

fields.label: Max Message Payload Size (MB)
fields.description: Largest message, attachments included, that can be sent or uploaded.

fields.label: Max Push Notifications
fields.description: Most new messages announced by push notifications per sync; any beyond that arrive silently.

fields.label: Process Pending Emails Batch Size
fields.description: Queued emails each processing run picks up.

fields.label: Process Pending Emails Max Batch Size
fields.description: Ceiling on the batch size, even when a larger one is requested.

fields.label: Mail Exchange Export Timeout
fields.description: Seconds an export job may run before the background worker stops it.

fields.label: Mail Exchange Import Timeout
fields.description: Seconds an import job may run before the background worker stops it.

fields.label: Scan Message Timeout
fields.description: Seconds to wait for spamd to answer a scan.

fields.label: Process Pending Emails Timeout
fields.description: Seconds a queue processing run may take before the background worker stops it.
Applies to every mail log: admin, push, inbound, outbound and exchange. DEBUG traces every step; use it only while investigating a problem.
fields.label: Log Level

fields.description: A log file is rotated once it grows past this size.
fields.label: Max Log File Size (MB)

fields.description: Rotated files kept per log; the oldest is deleted when a new one is started.
fields.label: Log Files Kept
